visual.name: zentrixGanttChart
visual.description: An advanced, performant Gantt chart with correct multi-level hierarchy rollup, working sort, milestone diamonds, dense-schedule virtualization, baselines, and dependency arrows.

dataRoles.description: Required. The task name — one row per task. Together with the parent path it forms the task's identity.
dataRoles.name: task

dataRoles.description: Optional. Unique task IDs (e.g. from MS Project / P6 exports) that Predecessor ID(s) reference. Without it, predecessors resolve by task name, then by 1-based row order.
dataRoles.name: taskId

dataRoles.description: Optional, multi-level. Add one or more grouping columns (e.g. Program, Project, Phase) to build the work-breakdown hierarchy. Order defines depth.
dataRoles.name: parent

dataRoles.description: Required. The task start. Accepts a date column (uses Earliest) or a DAX measure — date hierarchies are not needed here.
dataRoles.name: startDate

dataRoles.description: The task end. Accepts a date column (uses Latest) or a DAX measure. Provide either End date or Duration.
dataRoles.name: endDate

dataRoles.description: Task duration in days (working days if a calendar is configured). Provide either End date or Duration.
dataRoles.name: duration

dataRoles.description: Optional. Task progress as 0–1 or 0–100 (auto-detected). Parents roll up duration-weighted unless a Parent progress override is bound.
dataRoles.name: pctComplete

dataRoles.description: Optional. A truthy column/measure marking milestone rows. Zero-duration tasks are also auto-detected as milestones.
dataRoles.name: milestone

dataRoles.description: Optional. A category column (e.g. Status, Workstream) that colors bars and builds the legend.
dataRoles.name: legend

dataRoles.description: Optional, multiple. Any extra column or measure about a task. Each one shows in the task grid and the tooltip by default; the gear's Grid tab can hide it from either, or give it a special meaning (Link URL, Is critical, Sort order, Milestone image, Parent progress, KPI overlay) instead of it needing a field well of its own.
dataRoles.name: gridColumns

dataRoles.description: Optional. Comma-separated predecessor list per task, e.g. '12FS+2d, 14SS'. Drives dependency arrows (premium).
dataRoles.name: predecessor

dataRoles.description: Optional. The assigned resource/team — enables resource swimlanes (premium).
dataRoles.name: resource

dataRoles.description: Optional. Group the rows into one lane per distinct value of this field (set Layout → Group mode to Swimlane). Free — any category works.
dataRoles.name: swimlaneField

dataRoles.description: Optional, up to 3. Baseline start dates for plan-vs-actual ghost bars. Bind one field per baseline; the Nth Baseline start pairs with the Nth Baseline end.
dataRoles.name: baselineStart

dataRoles.description: Optional, up to 3. Baseline end dates, positionally paired with Baseline start.
dataRoles.name: baselineEnd

dataRoles.description: Optional. The schedule status/data date (e.g. last refresh or reporting cut-off) drawn as a second vertical line beside Today.
dataRoles.name: dataDate
milestoneDates
dataRoles.description: Extra milestone dates per task (bind several). Each column draws a diamond on the task's bar at that date; the column name is the milestone's label.

dataRoles.name: refLineDate
dataRoles.description: Vertical reference lines/bands (sprint ends, phase gates, deadlines). Bind several; each field is one line, labelled with that field's own name (rename it in the gear).

dataRoles.name: budgetCost
dataRoles.description: Optional. Budgeted cost per task (the BAC contribution) — the basis for earned-value: planned value, earned value, SPI/CPI and the S-curve. Milestones are excluded from cost roll-ups.

dataRoles.name: actualCost
dataRoles.description: Optional. Cost incurred to date per task. Without it earned value still computes, but the cost indices (CV, CPI, EAC) are reported as unavailable rather than assumed.

columnLinesOnHeader.displayName: Show column gridlines on the date scale
